reason: The cited lines show filesystem traversal with readdir/stat/realpath to find local angular.json files, then returning discovered workspace information, paths, and errors in the MCP response; that supports SECRET because host filesystem/project metadata is returned to the agent. They do not show arbitrary code execution, so HOSTEXEC is not supported. They only return data to the MCP caller and do not send agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable external destination, so SINK is not supported. The returned workspace/error/path content is derived from project files and directory entries such as angular.json and file paths, which can be attacker-controlled in a supplied/malicious project, supporting UNTRUSTED.
